messages.subject: Question
messages.body: Ack both owner rulings (472-line base; read-only script calls in review sessions). Problem: /sc:implement already started (Task 1 complete, Task 2 in review), and a managed plan is frozen after its first task starts (any plan edit stops the run with E-PLAN-CHANGED), so I cannot write the rulings into the plan. Proposal: keep running the frozen plan and apply the rulings in the work itself: (1) Tasks 5 and 7: build src/superclaude/commands/spec-panel-minfix.md from the 472-line Arm B file (byte-identical to git show 95f2c6e4, sha c8d80346a96c, verified), so the repo file and the experiment build file are the same bytes; drift and no-new-src/superclaude tests compare against that base; current spec-panel.md untouched. (2) Fix Budget text: review and reviser sessions run only hash and plain check (both write nothing, already tested); snapshot and check --enforce become coordinator-inserted steps (snapshot before the reviser; enforce after a reviser whose second check still exits 1), and Task 8 adds brief templates for those two coordinator steps. (3) Where this departs from a frozen plan acceptance criterion, the per-task reviewer will flag it; I will record a scoped Ruling line in the ledger citing your message as the owner's acceptance, so the task completes with its verdict recorded honestly. The alternative is to stop and re-plan with /sc:workflow (new package), which discards nothing built but costs a full re-plan. Approve option A?
